subject.title: Add gated Claw discovery and API projection

question: Should ClawHub adopt the proposed experimental `claw` package family and its gated public discovery/API contract as the supported registry direction before this stacked series lands?
rationale: This PR adds a new public package family, API projection, CLI surface, configuration gate, and long-lived compatibility boundary; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the product contract or its upgrade path.

options.title: Sponsor the gated experimental stack
options.body: Approve the experimental contract and require live runtime proof plus ordered review of the schema, publication, discovery, and feed slices before merge.

options.title: Defer the public registry surface
options.body: Keep the stack open but pause merge until the RFC or a narrower maintainer-owned design defines the supported package and API contract.

options.title: Narrow to internal groundwork
options.body: Ask for a reduced follow-up that retains only non-public validation groundwork and removes the CLI/API discovery contract until direction is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated experimental stack
recommendation.body: Approve the experimental contract and require live runtime proof plus ordered review of the schema, publication, discovery, and feed slices before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor spanning all four interdependent Claw contract slices, although final product acceptance remains a human repository decision.
